selection_boundary: Species were deliberately selected from extreme linkage or selectiveness classes and had to occur in at least two temporal networks. Generalized/specialized and opportunistic/selective are overlapping selection axes, so the 24 profile rows are not independent biological replicates.
independence_boundary: First-last changes are calculated within species x community x selection class, then averaged within species across communities. Monthly rows are repeated observations; two communities on one island do not create independent geological-origin replicates.
reading: The selected-species screen produced 3 nominal sign-test results below 0.05 across 24 profile families, but 0 remained below a Benjamini-Hochberg q-value of 0.05. The source therefore supports heterogeneous seasonal partner-trait trajectories, not a common multiplicity-robust direction or a geological-origin effect.
claim_boundary: This is a selected-species, within-source seasonal description. It does not reconstruct plant-by-visitor edges, estimate a full network response, measure pollinator effectiveness or effective dependency, or identify continental-versus-oceanic island causation.
